scope: Kysely required Insights model on SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and CockroachDB
publicCutover: deferred to the repository-wide atomic provider cutover

contract.eventCursor: namespace, selector, event-time upper cutoff, and descending (received_at_ms,id) keyset; no source-generation snapshot
contract.publicationCursor: durable source namespace, immutable publication, ordering revision, section, and filter
contract.installationOrder: shared SHA-256(JSON.stringify(full installation ID)) key with full-ID collision verification

sharedVerification.adversarialReview: GO; no remaining scoped P0 or P1 finding

coverage: live late-commit event cursor semantics
captured alias prefix ahead of 50,001 future aliases
interrupted populated migration and arbitrary-width poison
append rollback
full zero-filled reports
durable failed jobs and publication reuse

coverage: rev4 catalog and rank index
bounded native event plan and live late continuation
interrupted populated migration with append during backfill
oversized poison preflight
delayed latest identity and publication A after B

20,000-row rank noise plan
concurrent rollback and worker fencing

mysql.command: KYSELY_INSIGHTS_MYSQL_URL=<mysql-url> mise exec -- pnpm exec vitest run packages/server/src/adapters/sqlInsights/kysely/kyselyInsights.mysql.integration.spec.ts --project integration:default --reporter=verbose

defaultCi.command: mise exec -- pnpm exec vitest run packages/server/src/adapters/sqlInsights/kysely/kyselyInsights.mysql.integration.spec.ts packages/server/src/adapters/sqlInsights/kysely/kyselyInsights.postgresql.integration.spec.ts packages/server/src/adapters/sqlInsights/kysely/kyselyInsights.cockroachdb.integration.spec.ts --reporter=verbose

operationalModel.sourceClock: one short transaction locks the singleton state row to allocate a committed monotonic source sequence

limitations: Runtime durations are correctness evidence, not throughput benchmarks.
The single source-clock row is an intentional capacity model and is not a sharded allocator.
Repository-wide public provider wiring and standalone profile E2E remain separate atomic-cutover gates.
